race.description: The Ophir Hotel Dave Stanley Shenanigans 21st Nov Hcp (C1)
race.comment: KENNEDY COMPOUND (6) appeals as the main danger, coming back from a provincial BM64 at Kembla Grange into easier company after her sharp Mdn win at this track two starts ago. The new 1400m trip is the question, but her track record and third-up setup keep her right in play. MY BOY SCOUT (3) was close up at Dubbo last start after covering plenty of ground in the run when fifth over 1200m at Dubbo. Ready to deliver. OVERSHOOT (8) brings upside after charging home to win a Warren Mdn despite an awkward start and being held up, with the 1.5kg claim another small help. TOO HOT TO HANDLE (7) was plain in a Hawkesbury BM64, yet his previous track-and-trip Mdn win gives him a clear rebound case back in this company.
